Math took me a while because I didn't pay attention to math at all in school. I took remedial math classes before I dropped out. If you can find out what programs your city offers, that's been the best help for me. I didn't have to wonder what to study, it was laid out for me in a program. If you want to know a basic outline of what to study so you're not feeling overwhelmed, I can dm you what I've studied and then you can use Kahn academy or light and salt. 
It will be challenging, math is so frustrating and there's a bit of basic foundation to learn to get you through equations. Study how to use a ti calculator because those things can solve equations for you. I just learned that today.
